replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Been over 24 hours since this was checked out, so I'll respond;
There was a point in the video where they tried to hit you, but missed you. If they had forcefield, it would've been a successful hit, because you were in range of them. They also turned towards you a little bit, then they hit you once with the bow. Looked a little suspicious, but after looking at the former, theres also a chance that it was just a startle. More evidence (ex, them being in a battle w/other teammates against the enemy), would help. If you have any, feel free to create another report. Otherwise, I'm going to have to say that it's not quite enough to be 100% sure, due to those 2 moments. It's an awkward case. =/
